thread:
Carmen R: proposing we tighten and clarify the SLOs for GPU serving across regions. current problem: grafana alerts for slo burn are really noisy and spike on node restarts and short provisioning blips. would like feedback on the proposal below.

Carmen R: TL;DR suggestions:
- availability SLI = fraction of requests with status=200 and latency < 2s (regional, per-pool)
- latency SLI = p99 of inference-response-time (exclude background health-checks)
- saturation SLI = % windows where GPU_utilization > 90% (5m windows, per-pool)
- error budget reporting: weekly rollup + 24h burn-rate alert (avoid 5m flaps)

Ben L: overall +1. few notes:
- prefer using rolling-window burn rate (1h, 6h, 24h) instead of single window. it helps catch slow drifts.
- can we publish the prometheus queries so product teams can validate?

Carmen R: yep. initial queries i'm thinking (very rough):
```
# availability
sum(rate(inference_responses{code="200"}[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_requests[5m]))

# p99 latency (ms)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_response_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))

# saturation: percent of 5m windows with gpu_util > 0.9
sum(increase((gpu_utilization > 0.9)[5m])) / count_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m])
```
(we'll need to adapt for our metric names)

Dave H: can we add a synthetic canary per-region? park a tiny qps (0.5-1 rps) that measures cold-start tail and p99. that reduces noisy alerts from maintenance windows.

Amaia: cost/regional constraints: if we tighten SLOs (lower latency SLO or lower saturation threshold) sales/product will expect reserved capacity guarantees for certain customers. we should call out the cost delta in the proposal. also +1 on canaries.

Ben L: for alert tuning: replace instant 'SLO: burn > 0' alerts with two-tier alerts:
- warning: burn rate > 0.2 for 1h (informational, slack only)
- critical: projected burn > 1.0 for next 24h (pager)
this reduces pager noise and still protects budget.

Carmen R: agree. and add auto-rollforward policy: if a region is saturated > 4h and burn > 0.8, trigger routing to fallback model-variant (lower-cost quantized) and notify infra channel.

Dave H: implementation detail — prometheus exporter needs to expose per-pool `error_budget_spent` counter so we can `increase(error_budget_spent[1w])`. otherwise the query gets messy. can infra team add that metric?

infra-bot: scheduled a maintenance window for eu-west-1 gpu-pool at 2026-05-12T02:00Z — expected short restarts (10-20m). will tag grafana dashboards to mute non-critical slo burn alerts during window.

Carmen R: thanks infra-bot. i'll add an annotation to the SLO dashboard and draft the RFC for changes (sli defs + prometheus queries + alert thresholds + cost impact). ETA EOD Friday for RFC draft.

Ben L: small nit: exclude autoscaler health-check probes from request counts — they skew error rate during scale-up.

Carmen R: good catch, will add exclude filter `job!~"autoscaler|kube-probe"` to the queries.

Amaia: leaving a +1, and will work with finance on a short cost sketch for tightened SLO scenarios.

Dave H: will prototype canary job tomorrow and post results midday.

Carmen R: awesome — thanks all. if no objections i'll post RFC Friday and schedule a 30m review next Tue. :thumbsup:
